fact: UNFPA handed the Polícia Nacional 11 laptop computers and accessories to reinforce the informatisation of the 'Zulu' system, a process begun the previous year with five television sets; the force's inspector-general called Zulu 'our integrated police information system', and UNFPA expects from it the data the police collect, including on gender-based violence, daily, weekly and monthly. The text says nothing of which esquadras enter records.
title: UNFPA oferece 13 computadores a alguns parceiros
